title: QUIC RFC 9000 NEW_CONNECTION_ID Frame Focused Proof Work Item
summary: Fix and prove the RFC 9000 Section 19.15 NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame-field parser and formatter tail.
planned_changes:

- Add a focused NEW_CONNECTION_ID requirement-home helper for exact field encodings, truncated fields, and parser assertions.
- Add focused positive, negative, edge, and fuzz proof where required for S19P15 0001 through 0013.
- Link the focused proof to dedicated architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts.
- Regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage and run focused verification.
verification_plan: Run the focused S19P15 requirement-home filter, run a Release build, run the full Release no-build solution test suite, run the QuicFrameCodec benchmark Dry job, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, and check the diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: Changing peer connection-ID lifecycle policy for S19P15 0014 through 0023.
Adding hosted endpoint close-packet assertions for every malformed NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame.
Changing migration path selection or unlinkability policy beyond the frame parser/formatter seam.
Changing stateless reset token generation policy.
Replacing the span-backed NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame view or frame-codec hot path.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused parser/formatter correction and proof over the existing NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame codec, existing peer-CID lifecycle boundaries, and existing frame-codec benchmark floor.
